snippet.title: Bang! Trailer
snippet.description:
Gear up for some wild west action with Bang! in the arcade, the ultimate cowboy shootout experience! Step into the boots of a sharpshooting gunslinger as you take aim at bandits, outlaws, and dangerous foes in fast-paced, reflex-testing levels. With vibrant hand-drawn graphics, classic light-gun gameplay, and a thrilling western atmosphere, Bang! delivers an exciting, immersive experience that keeps you on the edge of your seat. Whether you're riding solo or taking on the action with friends, it's all about quick draws, precision shots, and high-score bragging rights. Saddle up, draw your weapon, and show the frontier who's boss in Bang!!

Find out more here:
PlayStation 👉 https://antstre.am/playstation
Xbox👉 https://www.xbox.com/en-GB/games/store/antstream-arcade/9N0BXMRL9X66/0010
And more 👉 https://www.antstream.com/

Turn your PlayStation into an entire retro gaming arcade! Antstream is bringing the largest collection of retro games, challenges & tournaments to PS4 & PS5. Challenge your friends, play couch co-op & rise to the top of our leaderboards across our games. From arcade classics to hidden gems & modern indie retro games Antstream has it all! www.Antstream.com for more details.

From classic arcade, to Mega Drive, C64, Amiga, up to PS1, we have it all & everything in between. With global leaderboards & unique challenges, there are even more ways for you to play your favourite retro games!
